title: Depth sweep: DEPTH=10 (bracketing between 8 and 12)
description: Changed only DEPTH from 8 to 10 in train.py, leaving ASPECT_RATIO/HEAD_DIM/all other hyperparameters unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb improved from 1.014027 (baseline, depth=8) to 1.002652 at depth=10 -- a meaningful win, confirming the fixed 5-min budget was not compute-optimal at depth=8 and benefits from a bigger model despite fewer optimizer steps. This complements depth=6 and depth=12 runs from other agents this round to give a full bracket (6/8/10/12) in one round. If depth=12 (a1's run) also beats baseline and beats 10, the optimum is likely >=12 and worth pushing further (14+) next round; if 12 is worse than 10, the optimum is near 10 and future rounds should fine-tune other hyperparameters (LR, batch size, warmdown) around this depth instead of depth itself.
